dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, did you hear the rumor about Mr. Brown?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dɪd juː ˈhɪr ðə ˈruːmər əˈbaʊt ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ploy told me that he was leaving the university.
dialogue.reading: ˈplɔɪ ˈtoʊld miː ðæt hiː wʌz ˈliːvɪŋ ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: She said a student in a different class told her.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈsɛd ə ˈstuːdənt ɪn ə ˈdɪfərənt ˈklæs ˈtoʊld hɜːr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then it's probably just gossip. That isn't a good source.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ɪts ˈprɑːbəbli ˈdʒʌst ˈɡɑːsɪp. ðæt ˈɪzənt ə ˈɡʊd ˈsɔːrs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Maybe, but the rumor is spreading fast. Everyone is talking about it.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi, bʌt ðə ˈruːmər ɪz ˈsprɛdɪŋ ˈfæst. ˈɛvriwʌn ɪz ˈtɔːkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: People often exaggerate. Oh, look! There's Mr. Brown.
dialogue.reading: ˈpiːpəl ˈɔːfən ɪɡˈzædʒəreɪt. ˈoʊ, ˈlʊk! ðɛrz ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown, Ploy told us that you were leaving. Is that right?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, ˈplɔɪ ˈtoʊld ʌs ðæt juː wɜːr ˈliːvɪŋ. ɪz ðæt ˈraɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Leaving? No! I told my class that I was moving to a new office.
dialogue.reading: ˈliːvɪŋ? ˈnoʊ! aɪ ˈtoʊld maɪ ˈklæs ðæt aɪ wʌz ˈmuːvɪŋ tu ə ˈnuː ˈɔːfɪs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. Please tell everyone that I'm not going anywhere!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈpliːz ˈtɛl ˈɛvriwʌn ðæt aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈɛniwɛr!
